purpose: Theme-aware reference data for inspectable, reversible ShopiFixer mutation planning. This registry does not authorize live-store mutation.
rules: No merchant theme change without snapshot, duplicate theme, preview, visual diff, approval, and rollback path.
Unknown or custom themes default to audit-only until structure is inspected.

theme_archetypes.known_structure: Shopify Online Store 2.0 reference theme with JSON templates, section groups, reusable sections, and app blocks.

recovered_memory.merchant_context: No Kings Athletics dev-store evidence recovered from local files and shell history.

known_file_targets.safe_mutation_zone: read-only classification unless editing a confirmed duplicate theme

known_file_targets.zone: product page block order and settings
known_file_targets.safe_mutation_zone: reorder existing product blocks or adjust existing block settings in a duplicate theme
additive rendering of approved snippets or product-page trust copy; preserve product form behavior
copy/class-level CTA clarity only after screenshots; no form logic rewrite
preserve as evidence or render only after explicit approval and before/after screenshots
scoped spacing, hierarchy, and CTA visibility changes only

safe_mutation_zones: CTA visibility and wording without product form logic changes
safe_mutation_types: section order adjustment in duplicate theme only
non-destructive CSS spacing or contrast adjustment
add existing theme block where supported
theme_archetypes.rollback_notes: Restore original theme duplicate or revert patch diff against captured pre-change files.

theme_archetypes.known_structure: Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme derived from Dawn patterns with product and brand storytelling sections.
common_conversion_issues: story content pushes purchase action too low
trust details hidden in collapsible blocks
safe_mutation_types: surface existing reviews or proof blocks
theme_archetypes.rollback_notes: Preserve original template JSON and section files before patch; rollback must restore product form behavior.

theme_archetypes.known_structure: Commercial theme with richer merchandising sections, theme settings, promotional blocks, and custom snippets.
common_conversion_issues: announcement/header stack takes too much mobile height
cart drawer upsells distract from checkout
safe_mutation_types: reduce non-critical section prominence in duplicate theme
change theme settings when exported and reversible
theme_archetypes.rollback_notes: Rollback must restore theme settings and custom snippets together; JS changes require extra proof.

theme_archetypes.known_structure: Premium editorial theme with luxury merchandising patterns, large media sections, and advanced product presentation.
common_conversion_issues: CTA appears too low on mobile
product proof is visually separated from buy box
safe_mutation_types: CTA visibility improvements within current layout
image weight recommendations without asset mutation
theme_archetypes.rollback_notes: Preserve media references and section settings; rollback must avoid losing brand art direction.

theme_archetypes.known_structure: Catalog-heavy commercial theme optimized for large inventories, filtering, collections, and merchandising modules.
common_conversion_issues: product cards lack urgency or proof
safe_mutation_types: mobile spacing adjustment in duplicate theme
risky_mutation_types: inventory or price display logic changes
theme_archetypes.rollback_notes: Rollback must preserve filtering/search behavior and product grid settings.
